title: Network Participation Agreements: How Many Agreements a Practice May Hold
content:
**Rule.** A practice may hold many **Network Participation Agreements**, so there is no fixed cap: one agreement per rendering provider (NPI), service location type and agreement type. A new application may not be opened for an NPI and agreement type that already has an agreement in credentialing, active or termination pending status. A provider may hold both a Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement and a Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement. Where both are active on a date of service, PPO-network plans pay the line as in-network PPO.

## What decides a duplicate

The test reads Cascade's agreement records, not what the practice says. It is applied before a new application is opened. The records are matched on two things together: the rendering provider's NPI and the agreement type applied for.

| Existing agreement for the same NPI and the same agreement type | New application for that NPI and agreement type |
|---|---|
| Status credentialing | May not be opened |
| Status active | May not be opened |
| Status termination pending | May not be opened |

The rule names only these three statuses as blocking a new application.

## No ceiling per practice

No fixed number limits how many agreements one practice holds. A group practice with several dentists holds one agreement per rendering provider, per service location type and per agreement type.

## Dual PPO and Premier participation

One provider may hold both the Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement and the Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement. When both are active on the date of service, a PPO-network plan pays the claim line as in-network PPO.

## Hypothetical cases

| Records on file (hypothetical) | New application | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| NPI A holds an active Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | NPI A, Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | Not opened |
| NPI A holds an active Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | NPI A, Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement | Not blocked by this rule (different agreement type) |
| NPI B has a Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement in credentialing | NPI B, Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement | Not opened |
| NPI C, same practice as NPI A, holds no agreement | NPI C, Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | Not blocked by this rule (different NPI) |
